title: Breezy Isle Garden - Match three, grow an island
short: Match three to grow sprouts into trees and huts into lighthouses on a tiny island in the sea breeze.
desc:
Place what's in your hand on a tiny 6×6 island in the sea breeze. When three or more of the same thing touch, they grow one step up on the cell you placed last.

Sprout → Bush → Tree → Hut → House → Windmill → Lighthouse → Star Tower

· Chain growth: a new item that touches more of its kind grows again in the same move.
· Gulls wander the island and take up space. Trap a flock and it turns into shells. Three shells make a pearl, three pearls make a treasure chest.
· Pouch: store your current piece and swap it back when you need it.
· A wind jar blows one filled cell away, and a rainbow seed becomes whatever makes the best match.
· Today's Isle: each date has its own starting island and piece order.
· Isle Guide: collect all 11 things you can grow and see your last seven daily scores.
· Your island is saved mid-game, so you can pick up where you left off.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in.

This app was planned and built with the help of AI tools.
